cloud.title: Connect to NetBird Cloud
cloud.description: Enter a personal access token with permission to read the account, peers, and topology.

self_hosted.title: Connect to self-hosted NetBird
self_hosted.description: Enter the HTTPS API origin and a token. The dashboard URL and PEM CA bundle are optional. Paths and redirects are not supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect NetBird
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement personal access token for the same NetBird account.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure NetBird
reconfigure.description: Enter replacement settings for the same NetBird account. Changes are saved only after the connection is validated.

error.invalid_auth: The personal access token is invalid or expired.
error.insufficient_permissions: The personal access token does not have permission to read the account and peers.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the NetBird API.
error.invalid_response: The NetBird API returned an invalid response.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin without a path, query, fragment, or credentials.
error.blocked_address: The URL resolves to a loopback, link-local, unspecified, or multicast address.
error.invalid_ca: The custom CA bundle is not a valid PEM certificate bundle.
error.redirect_not_allowed: The API returned a redirect. Use the final HTTPS API origin directly.
error.unsupported_server: This server does not provide the complete API contract required by the integration.

abort.already_configured: This NetBird account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The personal access token belongs to a different NetBird account.
abort.reconfigure_account_mismatch: The personal access token belongs to a different NetBird account.

invalid_auth.message: NetBird authentication failed. Update the personal access token.

insufficient_permissions.message: The NetBird token lacks permission to read the account or peers.

cannot_connect.message: The NetBird API is currently unreachable. Setup will retry.

invalid_response.message: The NetBird API returned an invalid account or peer response. Setup will retry.

unknown.message: An unexpected NetBird API error occurred. Setup will retry.

stale_peer_cleanup_blocked.title: Stale NetBird peer cleanup blocked
stale_peer_cleanup_blocked.description: Home Assistant kept a stale NetBird peer because its device has registry associations not owned by this integration entry. Review the device and its entities, remove foreign associations only if they are no longer needed, and allow the next successful NetBird refresh to retry cleanup.
